Resources

Information to Help You Choose with Confidence

WeMall provides practical resources to help individuals, families, care teams and providers understand products, funding pathways and purchasing requirements. From choosing the right product to understanding prescription and delivery requirements, our resources are designed to make informed decision-making easier.

Terms & Conditions

Understand the terms that apply when accessing and using WeMall, including important information about purchases, payments, supplier arrangements, delivery, returns and use of the platform.

Product Comparison

Compare relevant product features, specifications, pricing and other available information to better understand your options.

Product comparison is designed to support informed choice, whether you are purchasing privately or considering a product as part of a funded care arrangement.

AT-HM Prescription Guidance

Some assistive technology and home modification products may require assessment, recommendation or prescription by an appropriately qualified health professional.

Our AT-HM guidance helps individuals, families and care teams understand when additional professional input or supporting documentation may be required and what information may be needed before progressing with a purchase.

View SAH AT-HM Information

Funding FAQs

Find answers to common questions about purchasing products through Support at Home, NDIS and private funding arrangements, including quotations, approvals, supporting documentation and payment processes.

Funding eligibility and requirements depend on individual circumstances and the applicable funding program.

Delivery FAQs

Find practical information about delivery, estimated arrangements, installation, receiving your order and what to do if additional delivery support is required.

Specific delivery conditions, costs and timeframes may vary depending on the product, supplier and destination.

Returns

Understand the process for requesting a return, exchange or other post-purchase assistance.

Return arrangements may depend on the product, its condition, supplier requirements and applicable consumer rights.
